title: AI Agents and LLM Engineering

seo_title: AI Agent and LLM Engineering Skills for Claude and Codex
meta: AI agent and LLM engineering skills for Claude Code and Codex: prompt and context engineering, MCP servers, evals, subagents and model training.
intro: Skills that help an agent build, steer and evaluate other AI systems: prompt and context engineering, MCP servers, evals, subagent workflows, and model training and inference. Each one ships as a SKILL.md folder your agent loads only when the task calls for it.
guide: Start from the system you are building. Skills for a specific framework or model provider carry that provider's conventions, so they beat general prompting advice when you already know your stack.

Check what a skill expects to run. Training and inference skills often name GPU tooling, cloud credentials or a model hub token; the Before you install panel on each page lists the scripts it bundles and the environment variables its code reads.

For agent workflow skills (planning, subagents, review loops), read the SKILL.md body first. They change how your agent works on every task, so pick one method and stay with it rather than stacking overlapping ones.

title: Developer Tools and Frameworks

seo_title: Developer Tool and Framework Skills for Claude and Codex

intro: Framework, language, SDK and CLI skills that teach an agent the conventions of a specific stack, from Flutter and Rust to GraphQL, Git and mobile builds. Install the ones that match your codebase and the agent follows that stack's rules without a long prompt.

Look for the Official tag. Skills published by the company behind a framework or SDK track its current APIs, and the directory marks them on every page.
Several collections ship one skill per framework task. Installing the whole repository is one command; installing only the skills for your stack keeps the agent's routing list short.

guide: Decide whether you need a method or a data source. Some marketing skills are pure procedure (briefs, positioning, copy frameworks); others call a paid data API for rankings or ad libraries and list its key under Before you install.

Read the output format in each SKILL.md. Skills that end in a checklist, a scored audit or a ready-to-paste draft are easy to review; open-ended ones need a clearer prompt from you.
